map.A/B 测试解读：算出转化率的 95% 置信区间，若两个方案的区间大量重叠，说明: A/B test interpretation: compute the 95% confidence interval of the conversion rate; if the intervals of two variants overlap heavily, the sample size is not yet enough to decide which is better.
map.选择数据类型：均值还是比例: Choose the data type: mean or proportion
map.填样本量 n 与样本均值（或比例）: Enter the sample size n and the sample mean (or proportion)
map.填样本标准差（均值场景需要；比例场景由 p 推导）: Enter the sample standard deviation (needed for the mean scenario; derived from p in the proportion scenario)
map.看区间宽度：两方案区间重叠越多，说明样本量还不足以判定优劣: Look at the interval width: the more the two variants' intervals overlap, the less the sample size suffices to decide which is better
map.重复抽样下约 95% 的区间覆盖真值，非“真值有 95% 概率落此区间”。: Under repeated sampling about 95% of the intervals cover the true value, not "the true value has a 95% probability of falling in this interval".
map.样本多小就不准了？: How small does the sample have to be before it becomes inaccurate?
map.区间宽度与 √n 成反比，样本量翻 4 倍区间才缩窄一半。样本很小（如 n<30: The interval width is inversely proportional to sqrt(n); the interval only halves when the sample size quadruples. With very small samples (such as n<30) or a proportion near 0/1 the normal approximation fails and an exact method (such as Clopper-Pearson) or the t distribution should be used instead. Such intervals are often very wide, so no strong conclusion should be drawn from them.
